statement: The unchanged movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live scenario reports priority metric 0 on one fresh run, and while the existing background formation-release handoff is active, authoritative topology-shaping replica work resets its maturity clock so ordinary work remains closed until the existing 60000ms admission interval plus 10000ms observation handoff has elapsed after operation drain; priority recovery stays exempt and ordinary work never rearms the fence after release.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.
Use the existing replica-operation liveness and topology-shaping classifiers; do not add a second operation-accounting owner, snapshot authority, or demo-specific admission flag.

Only a still-active formation release scope may have its clear clock reset by in-flight topology-shaping work. Once released, ordinary work must not rearm or serialize itself behind the formation fence.

Priority partitions remain exempt from the background release fence; ledger exclusivity, quorum and voter safety, remove-safety authorities, operation accounting, and schema admission predicates remain unchanged.

Before the live run, prove through the production planning-gate path that work appearing after priority-spread clear resets the active clock, release remains closed through 60000ms plus the existing observation handoff after drain, priority recovery stays exempt, and post-release ordinary work cannot rearm the fence.
